title: UN Commission finding on sexual violence during abductions
affected_population: people abducted during the 7 October attacks
summary: The Commission addressed sexual and gender-based violence committed during abductions in the 7 October attacks.
claim: The Commission found reasonable grounds to conclude that members of Palestinian armed groups committed sexual and gender-based violence during the abduction of people in Israel on 7 October 2023.
legal_characterization: Factual finding by a UN commission applying a reasonable-grounds standard; it concerns violence during abduction, not treatment in captivity, and is not a judicial judgment or conviction.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Report of the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
verification_notes: Verified against the Commission’s discussion of sexual and gender-based violence in paragraphs 40-44 of A/HRC/56/26 and its reasonable-grounds standard in paragraph 6. The claim is limited to violence during abduction on 7 October; it makes no finding about hostage treatment in captivity and does not import findings about Israeli security forces’ treatment of Palestinian detainees.
